sources.title: DNR Officials Will No Longer Use Fire Lookout Towers

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Central US Lookouts page gives only county and survey code; its 44N-1E-34 code was not checked against the coordinates, and the brief's agency value 44N is a survey code, so it is proposed for removal. The 1940 date is the field-work year of a 1950 map, not a build date. The FFLA list supplies the gone status. Six page reads and two searches found no site description or staffing record. The WPR article is undated in the copy read (cache metadata gives 2015-12-17), so the story does not date that statement.
